title: Mortgage Pre-Approval Expiration and Renewal
content:
A Mortgage Pre-Approval expires the day after its expiration date, and its letters are void. At Larkspur Home Lending, a renewal brings an expired pre-approval back to issued under the conditions below.

## The rule

A pre-approval expires the day after its expiration date and its letters are void. A renewal is granted at most the level's allowed number of renewals and sets the issued date to the renewal date and the expiration date to the renewal date plus the level's renewal validity in calendar days. An expired pre-approval is renewed only while its credit report is no older than the credit refresh age, counted from the credit pull date; an older report needs a new pull first. Count calendar days forward from the credit pull date, which is day zero; a renewal on the last day of the count may reuse the report. Where the level requires a renewal to re-review documents, income and asset documents older than the level's document age limit are re-reviewed first. A renewal after a new pull re-tests every issuance check and may come back at different amounts.

The credit refresh age is the level's credit report age, in days, beyond which a renewal needs a new pull. The credit pull date is the date of the credit report the pre-approval rests on, as shown on the pre-approval's record.

## Training questions and answers

**When does the pre-approval stop being valid?**
The expiration date is the last day the pre-approval and its letters are valid. The pre-approval expires on the following day, when the expiration date has passed, and its letters are void from then. Hypothetical dates: with an expiration date of 30 May, the pre-approval is valid on 30 May and expired on 31 May.

**What does a renewal change?**
The status returns from expired to issued; the issued date becomes the renewal date; the expiration date becomes the renewal date plus the level's renewal validity in calendar days; and the number of renewals granted rises by one. Hypothetical dates: a renewal on 10 June at a level whose renewal validity were 60 calendar days sets the expiration date to 9 August.

**How many renewals are possible?**
At most the level's allowed number. Hypothetical case: at a level allowing two renewals, a pre-approval already renewed twice is not renewed again.

**When can the existing credit report be reused?**
Count calendar days forward from the credit pull date, which is day zero. The report may be reused for a renewal on any day up to and including the last day of the count, the day numbered the same as the credit refresh age. From the next day the report is older than the credit refresh age, and a new pull is needed first.

| Hypothetical credit pull date 1 March, credit refresh age 120 days | Day of the count | Report |
|---|---|---|
| Renewal on 28 June | day 119 | may be reused |
| Renewal on 29 June | day 120, the last day of the count | may be reused |
| Renewal on 30 June | day 121 | older than the refresh age; a new pull is needed first |

**What about income and asset documents?**
Where the level requires a renewal to re-review documents, income and asset documents older than the level's document age limit are re-reviewed first.

**Are the amounts the same after renewal?**
A renewal after a new pull re-tests every issuance check and may come back at different amounts. The credit pull date and credit score on the record are those of the report the renewed pre-approval rests on.
